seo.description: How Asian Technocast handles personal data submitted through this website, including rights under the GDPR and UK GDPR.

sections.title: Who is responsible
paragraphs: Asian Technocast, Plot No. 185, M Road, Aji GIDC, Rajkot 360003, Gujarat, India. Email: [[TODO: business email]]. [[TODO: confirm legal entity type and owner names for the controller statement]]

sections.title: What we collect and why
paragraphs: Request a Quote form: name, company, country, email, phone (optional), product and project details, and any drawings you upload. We use this only to answer your enquiry and prepare a quotation. Legal basis: steps prior to entering into a contract and our legitimate interest in answering business enquiries (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR / UK GDPR).

Email, phone and WhatsApp: if you contact us directly, we process the details you send to reply to you. WhatsApp is operated by WhatsApp Ireland Ltd / Meta; their privacy policy applies when you use it.

Server logs: our hosting provider records technical data such as IP address, browser type and time of access to deliver the site securely. Legal basis: legitimate interest in operating a secure website (Art. 6(1)(f)).

sections.title: Cookies and tracking
paragraphs: This website does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, so no cookie banner is shown.

Spam protection on the quote form uses Cloudflare Turnstile, which processes technical data (such as IP address and browser characteristics) to tell people from bots. It does not set tracking cookies.
The map on the contact page is only loaded from Google if you click 'Load map'.

list: Vercel Inc. (USA): website hosting and storage of uploaded drawings

Cloudflare Inc. (USA): spam protection (Turnstile)
